flags.claims_policy: Headline performance claims belong to forward paper-trading windows (recent live runs on unresolved outcomes). Historical replays are qualitative evidence only.
flags.fundamentals_bias: fundamentals excluded from replay: opt in to the point-in-time SEC EDGAR source with --sec-edgar-fundamentals
flags.news_rule: news items filtered to published <= decision date

calibration.event: the call's direction beats SPY over the horizon (alpha_pct > 0)

all_hold.note: every decision HOLD scores 0 net after costs

momentum.verdict: CI [-1.02%, +3.09%] crosses 0: not distinguishable from no edge
